blurb: Missouri River Outfitters offers 3-6 day guided trips and day trips on the Missouri River, as well as canoe and kayak rentals and shuttle services. They cater to groups of all sizes and provide logistical support and equipment. The outfitter emphasizes conservation and Leave No Trace principles, offering quiet water trips without motorized boats.
